name: Shimotsuki Kai
source:
4th year university student.
Star Sign: Virgo
Hobby: Cameras
Likes: Sleeping, Junk Food
Dislikes: Waking up early, Things that are difficult to eat

One of the protagonist's friends from university. He's in the same class as her despite the fact that he's older because he had to repeat some classes.
He's an aimless guy whose only important possession is his camera, he only takes landscape pictures however.
